articles.text: WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ àiren lái le ma?
COMRADE WÁNG: Has your wife come?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Tā hái méi lái. Tā míngtian lái.
MR. LǏ: She hasn't come yet. She's coming tomorrow.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ péngyou ne? Tā shénme shíhou dào?
COMRADE WÁNG: And your friend? When is he arriving?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Tā yǐjing dào le. Tā shi zuótian dàode.
MR. LǏ: He has already arrived. He arrived yesterday.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Tā shi yíge rén láide ma?
COMRADE WÁNG: Did he come alone?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Bú shi, tā bú shi yíge rén láide.
MR. LǏ: No, he didn't come alone.
COMRADE WÁNG: What day are you leaving?
LǏ XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ hòutian zǒu. Wǒ àiren yě hòutian zǒu.
MR. LǏ: I'm leaving the day after tomorrow. My wife is leaving then too.
